subject: Analysis of 2021 MCAS Results
overview: The School Committee reviewed 2021 MCAS performance in Mathematics, Science, and English Language Arts, focusing on pandemic-related shifts and curriculum adjustments. The body voted to include alternative assessment data in future reports and discussed strategies for closing achievement gaps among student subgroups.

items.title: Mathematics Results and Action Items
items.summary: Presented district-wide math scores and growth percentiles, highlighting the transition to inquiry-based learning and the restructuring of middle school acceleration pathways.

items.title: Data Embargo and Reporting Process
items.summary: Discussed the timing of state-mandated data releases and requested that the committee receive detailed reports earlier in the future to allow for more thorough analysis.

items.title: MCAS-Alt Data Reporting
items.summary: Approved a motion to include MCAS Alternative Assessment (MCAS-Alt) data in all future annual district reports.

items.title: Science and Technology Results
items.summary: Reviewed science performance across grades five, eight, and high school, noting a transition to online testing and the full implementation of the FOSS curriculum.

items.title: English Language Arts Performance
items.summary: Presented ELA results showing that district growth percentiles exceeded state averages in several grades and detailed efforts to increase text diversity and inclusivity.

items.title: Subgroup Performance and Resource Allocation
items.summary: Discussed achievement gaps among specific student subgroups and requested standardized data formats to better compare outcomes across different subjects.
